description:
You are acting as an Ethics Officer. A new complaint case has been filed regarding 'Drake Antiquities'. Management wants to assign investigator 'Elena Fisher' to this case, but first, you must check for conflicts of interest.

1. Find the NEW active case regarding 'Drake Antiquities'.
2. Search the system for any HISTORICAL (closed) cases involving 'Drake Antiquities'.
3. Review the historical case details. If 'Elena Fisher' was the investigator or involved, this is a conflict.
4. If a conflict is found, add a Note to the NEW case with the exact text: 'Conflict Detected: Elena Fisher involved in prior Case [OLD_CASE_ID]'.
   (Replace [OLD_CASE_ID] with the actual ID of the historical case you found, e.g., 2023-COMP-005).
